# o11y_alert_runbook (Data Source)

Reads the current authoritative revision of a managed alert runbook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "runbook_id" {
  description = "id of an o11y_alert_runbook."
  type        = string
}

data "o11y_alert_runbook" "checkout" {
  runbook_id = var.runbook_id
}

output "checkout_runbook_revision" {
  value = data.o11y_alert_runbook.checkout.current_revision_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `runbook_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean)
- `content_hash` (String)
- `current_change_reason` (String)
- `current_revision_id` (String)
- `markdown` (String)
- `owner_team_id` (String)
- `owner_user_id` (String)
- `provenance` (String)
- `provenance_ref` (String)
- `rendered_html` (String)
- `revision` (Number)
- `runbook_key` (String)
- `title` (String)
